comparisons.peer_summary: AMD provides CPUs, APUs, and chipsets for desktops and notebooks with AI capabilities and security features, and uses GPUs with software to power immersive gaming experiences.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and NVIDIA disclose that they leverage GPUs combined with software to power immersive gaming experiences. NVIDIA specifically highlights its RTX technology, which integrates real-time ray tracing and DLSS (an AI technology) to boost frame rates and enhance rendering quality. AMD describes a similar approach where its GPUs, including discrete and semi-custom SoCs, work together with software to deliver immersive gaming on PCs, consoles, and cloud services. While NVIDIA explicitly details the AI-driven features (DLSS) and claims leadership in the 'AI PC' space with specific installed base metrics, AMD's disclosure focuses more broadly on the collaboration of hardware (GPUs/APUs) and software without detailing specific AI algorithms like DLSS in this context.

sentences.text: We developed NVIDIA RTX to bring next generation graphics and AI to games.
NVIDIA RTX also features deep learning super sampling, or NVIDIA DLSS, our AI technology that boosts frame rates while generating beautiful, sharp images for games.

We drive innovation with our line-up of CPUs, APUs and chipsets for desktops and notebooks, to bring performance, efficiency, AI capabilities and modern security features to gamers, creators, consumers and enterprises.

Our GPUs, including discrete GPUs, semi-custom SoC products and development services, work together with software to power immersive gaming experiences for PCs, game consoles and cloud gaming services.
